svg.title: Kuroshio 2024: twelve dated regional model snapshots at 0.49 m
svg.desc: East China Sea and Luzon Strait. Separate axis and left/right smoothed model boundaries. First day of each month, not monthly means. Length uses18–30N gates. Fixed24.5N span is oblique, not a flow-normal width. Missing source vertices break lines.
svg.text: Kuroshio · twelve dated 2024 model snapshots · 0.49 m
GLORYS12V1 curves: solid navy axis · dashed purple left · dotted teal right.
Length: 18–30°N regional axis. Span: fixed 24.5°N section; not a flow-normal width.
First day of month, not monthly mean. Fallback edge censoring is unknown.
OSW derived dimensions; equirectangular display. Natural Earth land1:10 million v5.1.1, public domain; map scale is not positional accuracy.
No whole-current measurement, physical annual extrema, uncertainty interval, NASA association or occupied-area polygon inferred.
